tools.name: x509_certificate_inspect
tools.description: Inspect an X.509 PEM/DER TLS certificate using Node crypto.X509Certificate for subject, issuer, SANs, expiry, fingerprint256, and key type.

tools.name: saml_assertion_decode
tools.description: Decode Base64 / URL-encoded / Deflate SAML 2.0 AuthnRequests or Responses and extract Issuer, NameID, Audience, and validity timestamps.

tools.name: jwt_decode_and_audit
tools.description: Decode JWT header & payload, flag alg=none / weak secrets / expired exp claims, and optionally verify HS256/HS512 signatures.

tools.name: pgp_packet_inspect
tools.description: Parse ASCII-armored OpenPGP public/private keys or signatures to decode RFC-4880 packet tags, RSA/EdDSA versions, CRC24 armor checksum, and User IDs.

tools.name: crypto_keypair_generate
tools.description: Generate fresh Ed25519 or RSA-2048/4096 PKCS#8/SPKI PEM keypairs and SHA-256 public key fingerprints via Node crypto.

tools.name: ssh_config_generate_and_audit
tools.description: Generate hardened ~/.ssh/config stanzas (JumpHost/ProxyJump, IdentityFile, IdentitiesOnly, ServerAliveInterval) or audit existing SSH configs.

tools.name: ssh_known_hosts_inspect
tools.description: Inspect ~/.ssh/known_hosts entries for hashed vs plaintext hostnames, deprecated ssh-dss/ssh-rsa keys, and duplicate key fingerprints.

tools.name: csp_parse_and_audit
tools.description: Parse, build, or security-audit Content-Security-Policy (CSP) headers for unsafe-inline, unsafe-eval, wildcard sources, and missing frame-ancestors.

tools.name: cors_preflight_simulate
tools.description: Simulate a browser CORS preflight check against Access-Control-Allow-Origin, Allow-Credentials, and Allow-Methods rules and flag RFC misconfigurations.

tools.name: permissions_policy_audit
tools.description: Parse or build HTTP Permissions-Policy feature allowlists (camera, microphone, geolocation, usb, payment) and flag wildcard feature exposure.

tools.name: referrer_policy_audit
tools.description: Evaluate HTTP Referrer-Policy values for cross-origin query string/URL leakage risk and recommend strict alternatives.

tools.name: ioc_defang_and_refang
tools.description: Safely defang or refang malicious IOC URLs, domains, email addresses, and IPv4 indicators (hxxp://, [.], [@]) for SOC reports.

tools.name: sbom_inspect_and_audit
tools.description: Inspect CycloneDX or SPDX JSON Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) to count components, extract PURLs, and summarize license distribution.

tools.name: spdx_license_compatibility
tools.description: Classify SPDX open-source license identifiers (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, GPL-3.0, AGPL-3.0) by copyleft tier, patent grant, and commercial risk.

tools.name: package_json_audit
tools.description: Audit an npm package.json manifest for unpinned git/http dependencies, risky preinstall/postinstall lifecycle hooks, and missing engines/exports.

tools.name: lockfile_integrity_audit
tools.description: Audit npm package-lock.json (v2/v3) for non-HTTPS registry URLs, missing SHA-512 integrity hashes, and total transitive package footprint.

tools.name: password_kdf_hash_and_verify
tools.description: Hash and verify passwords using cryptographic scrypt or PBKDF2-SHA512 with random 16-byte salts via Node crypto.

tools.name: aes_gcm_encrypt_decrypt
tools.description: Authenticated AES-256-GCM encryption and decryption using Node crypto with random 96-bit IVs and 128-bit GCM auth tags.

tools.name: hmac_sign_and_verify
tools.description: Compute or timing-safe verify HMAC-SHA256 / HMAC-SHA512 message authentication codes.

tools.name: bip39_entropy_mnemonic
tools.description: Generate 128-bit or 256-bit cryptographic entropy with its exact BIP-39 SHA-256 checksum bits and 11-bit word indices.
